avis.titre: To be or not to be?!
avis.texte: I have been wanting to add a peel shot to my skin care line up, for quite some time now. Originally I was looking at Dr Malaxin but I came across this and I have multiple products from Medicube and have always been a big fan of their stuff. And once again I was not let down. This stuff works like magic. It doesn't clear everything up but it does well enough for my liking. My only complaint is, same as everyone else, THE AWFUL DROPPER... It is hard to get anything out having to squeeze multiple times to get anything into the dropper. So I had a old product that was almost gone that had a dropper in it, about the same size and I just use that when I use this product and it works fine. Although I shouldn't have to do that. With that being said, please Medicube come up with a better dropper...

avis.titre: Great for guys too.Great for guys too.
avis.texte: First of all, I am a guy....a 52 year old, former active duty Marine. This matters because it gives you an idea of what my previous idea of what skin care is. This year I realized my face was starting to look....old. I have been using this for a bit now, and along with a super basic skin care routine, my skin looks visibily younger and more healthy. It's also evening out my skin so it doesn't get as oily and gross as it used to. This product is a big part of that. At first, I thought the stuff that was coming off was just the product balling up after congealing. However,as I started using it daily, less and less started coming off, even though I wasn't using less. My lady friend even noticed that my face became much softer! We gents need to start paying more attention to their skin, because being 55 and looking like someone out of the great depression is not whats got in the streets. It doesn't have to be hard or a lot, use a face wash, get rid of dead skin, moisturize. This product works great to get rid of dead skin, while not feeling like you are rubbing sand over it, while keeping it looking great. Trust me, your partner will love it as well

avis.titre: UPDATED & HAPPY!!! PLEASE READ!!! 🥰UPDATED & HAPPY!!! PLEASE READ!!! 🥰
avis.texte: POSITIVE UPDATE: I changed my review status from 1 star to 4 stars! It would have been 5 stars except for the 2 cons at the end of this updated review. It took a little practice, but I figured out how to make this Peel Shot work for me. I was applying it more than once on my sensitive areas (like my cheeks) and scrubbing way too hard. What I do now is work one small section at a time and then lightly wipe the remaining product off with a hand towel or microfiber face cloth. There are areas I can apply the peel more than once if needed like my chin, around my mouth and my temples. As long as you are getting pill off, you are still removing impurities from your skin. Once nothing happens you know your face is beautiful, smooth, and soft. But be mindful of your sensitive areas or you will ruin your natural skin barrier. CON #1: Along with everyone else, the dropper does not work. I just turn the bottle upside down and dab the amount I need onto my first two fingers for each section of my face. NOTE....... Before you put the dropper back into the bottle, tap the bottle onto the counter a few times to let the product settle back down. Otherwise when you put the dropper back in, you will have a mess on your hands. CON #2: If you are using it around areas that have some hair (like your temples or peach fuzz), when you wipe off the excess you WILL have a few dried pieces of pill that you'll need to pull off. It's irritating, but I just use my 30X mirror to make sure I get them all. G

I love this!! I know there’s a lot of debate about if it really clears blackheads, or if it’s just the product rolling up. Yes, of course it’s the product rolling up, that should be obviously because it doesn’t just disappear! The product grabs the dirt and oil, so it rolls up with the product. Reaults? My face feels ridiculously soft and smooth and my pores are MUCH less noticeable! It definitely exfoliates my skin and makes it feel amazing! When my kids heard me talking, they wanted to feel. They felt my face and said “omg mom! It’s so soft!! You look beautiful!!” Just don’t be dumb like me lol.. I used Dr. Melaxins peel shot first, used almost the entire bottle before realizing I was supposed to use this on dry skin lol. By then, I started using Medicube products, and the difference on dry skin was amazing!

avis.titre: ⭐⭐⭐⭐⭐ Absolutely Amazing – A Must-Have Skincare Product!
avis.texte: I cannot say enough positive things about this product! It has quickly become one of my favorite skincare purchases. My skin feels smoother, looks brighter, and my pores appear much cleaner after using it consistently. The formula is gentle enough for regular use but still does an amazing job exfoliating and helping with blackheads and clogged pores without irritating my skin. This is absolutely a must-have purchase. If you're considering trying it, don't hesitate—you won't regret it! I will definitely be buying this again.

Soooo good! Gets the dry skin off my face and is so gentle! I used to use the exfoliates with the beads in it and learned that damages my skin barrier. This leaves my face feeling brand new without the damage!

I am a exfoliator daily for many years. I got this as an additional item to use. I have only had a few days and use 1x daily so far. I don't see my skin having a shine like I thought. Maybe need to use for a couple weeks for true results. I like the way it goes on. I do not like the application method. It gives a small amount out of dropped and I need four drops. One other thing I don't care for but not a big deal is the little blue rice pieces put in that don't dissolve bounce all over. I don't see any skin peeling either. Maybe I don't need the product?

avis.titre: Pratico da usare e perfetto per una skincare completaPratico da usare e perfetto per una skincare completa
avis.texte: Ottimo. Avevo già quello body, è praticamente la stessa cosa ma pensato per il viso. All’inizio ero scettica, ma funziona veramente. Testato più volte sullo stesso punto di utilizzo, la prima volta fa i pallini grigi, la seconda volta sullo stesso punto non li fa più, quindi escluderei che i pallini si fanno a prescindere. L’erogatore a pipetta è comodo perché permette di prelevare il prodotto facilmente e senza sprechi. Il packaging Medicube è come sempre molto curato e dà subito l’impressione di un prodotto pensato per una skincare strutturata. ❌È comunque un prodotto che va inserito nella routine con criterio: non lo considererei uno di quei prodotti da utilizzare casualmente ogni volta che capita. Interessante soprattutto per chi conosce già la skincare coreana e vuole aggiungere un trattamento specifico alla propria routine. Da utilizzare con criterio, 2/3 volte la settimana massimo. Per chi invece cerca semplicemente un prodotto base per lavare e idratare il viso, probabilmente ci sono soluzioni più semplici.

The whole bobbling of dirt is theatric because in the composition of the serum is exactly that material that cause the bobbling with that being said, the peeling is happening but is quite a gentle one, not going to cause the dead skin to be ripped apart. But overall great product, gentle on the skin, the bobbling effect is the whole fun and not irritating (coming from someone with quite sensitive/acne prone skin).
These two products right here are amazing. I would recommend buying them. At first, I didn’t trust the hype, but the hype was worth it and it leaves my face and my skin so so smooth and relaxed 10/10
I absolutely love medicube but, this one hit it out of the park. If you have a lot of dead skin or blackheads try this product. You won't regret it!

I have been using Hypochlorous for years for healing things like body piercings, and was so excited to order the Hypochlorous Acid Rice Peel Shot from Medicube. This is the social media hype product right now and it’s absolutely incredible. With great ingredients, like the HCOI, Black Rice Extract, Rice Bran Water, Panthenol, and Sodium Hyaluronate, it’s awesome. The effectiveness is even more awesome. This is easy to use - wash and dry your face, apply a dropper full to your hands or face and then massage into your face and rinse off when done. I massaged my face for about two minutes and the more I rubbed, the more I felt the dead skin ball up on my hands and on my face. It is a very satisfying process! I was so excited that I demonstrated this on my arm for my husband with the same success. He then used it on his own face and today he is walking around bragging about how great his face looks and how soft his face feels. This stuff is an absolute game changer for skincare! Beyond removing excess sebum, it’s great for removing pore impurities, and soothing irritated skin for a healthier and cleaner complexion. It is unscented, an interesting silver color and rinses off clean. My husband has very sensitive skin and neither of us had any adverse reactions at all, only great results. avis.titre: Left My Skin Soft But The Bottle Was Frustrating To Use
avis.texte: I’m giving this 4 stars because I really wanted to love it. I’ve used several products from this brand before and have had good experiences, so I was excited to try this one. I have combination, acne-prone skin and one thing I did like is that my skin felt noticeably soft after using it. The formula itself felt nice on my skin and didn’t leave any sticky residue behind after rinsing. I also had no stinging, redness, or irritation after using it, which is always important for me when trying new skincare products. It didn’t have a noticeable scent, and it layered well with my serums afterward without any issues. My biggest complaint is the bottle and dispensing design. It was difficult to get the product out and only a very small amount would come out at a time. I found myself having to try multiple times just to get enough product. That became frustrating enough that I honestly wasn’t as consistent with using it as I wanted to be. The actual product wasn’t bad and I did like how soft my skin felt afterward, but the packaging negatively impacted the overall experience for me. Unfortunately I personally would not repurchase unless the dispensing issue was improved.

This is similar to a Japanese gommage I've previously used. Apply to clean dry skin, massage in circular motion until it's like eraser particles and then you rinse it. This is very gentle and despite being gentle on the skin, it should only be used once or twice a week and not more often. Leaves skin visibly smoother and brighter and helps unclog pores. I didn't experience any tightness after washing, face feels soft and moisturized before I applied other skincare products.

I love medicube skincare, so once I saw they had a Hypochlorous Acid Rice Peel Shot, I had to investigate. If anything, this is meant to be a gentle exfoliating serum to help remove dead, dull skin cells from the skin's surface, as well as treat your pores, help breakdown sebum and blackheads. This uses rice extract along with polymers in the formula to gently exfoliate the skin's surface. Followed by the soothing, healing and cleansing properties of hypochlorous acid, and hydration of panthenol and allantonin to help smooth out the skin's surface to help create a stronger skin barrier. Upon receipt, the first question I have about this is, how much of the hypochlorus acid's concentration is reduced when exposing it to air this much as it alone can degrade quickly. If anything, I would definitely feel more confident on it's consistency in results, if this was simply in a bottle with a pump. Moving on, the solution itself is a very thick gel that's clear with little rice extract bits, with no scent, and managed with a dropper. As I rub it into the skin, the polymers encapsulate the rice extracts and becomes slightly bouncy, teeny, tiny silicone-like balls that help remove the aforementioned dull and dead skin. For me, this is more tangible evidence that something is working. The fact that I can clearly see and feel a difference in my skin after the first use, makes me feel more optimistic here than not at all. It washes off easily, and the smoothness in my skin along with a li

This is my first time trying a medicube product, and it did not disappoint. I definitely understand the hype now. This is also my first time trying a peel shot product and I feel like I’ve been missing out. I’m a tretinoin user, so my skin is constantly peeling but I can’t really use many exfoliating products because most of them are too harsh for my sensitive skin. This peel shot totally takes care of all that old dead skin without over exfoliating the skin. No more harsh rubbing. The wasn’t any overpowering fragrance or other irritants and my skin felt smooth without being overly dry. I’m totally sold. This is definitely something I’ll incorporate into my evening skincare routine several times a week. Would order this again!

avis.titre: My Face Feels Like Freshly Polished Rice
avis.texte: I made sure to follow the suggested way on how to apply the medicube Hypochlorous Acid Rice Peel Shot to my skin with my nightly routine, where, after cleansing, I incorporated this serum after toning lightly with a balancing toner, where a little of this serum goes a long way. I noticed a pleasant, slightly textured consistency with tiny granules of sorts, to genuinely help exfoliate dead skin and gunk without working too hard. I love the level of clean my skin feels and am comfortable using a reputable brand for some pore care, and removing any extra sebum control during my nightly routine. I finished my nightly routine with my usual serum and moisturizers all fitting into place together. I will absolutely keep this peel in my skincare routine.

I applied this Medicube Hypochlorous Acid Peel Shot immediately after cleansing my skin. As soon as I began to rub it on my skin, I felt it balling up under my fingertips. I wasn't sure if it was dead skin cells or the product itself that was balling up. Once I rinsed my face clean, it was apparent that it did infact exfoliate my skin. My face was super smooth and so soft afterwards. The process truly was gentle with no irritation or dryness from using this product. I'm really impressed with the amazing results I received in so little time. The Medicube Hypochlorous Acid Peel Shot comes in a 2.7 ounce (80 mL) thick plastic bottle with a glass eyedropper. I fell like it's a good value at the current price of $24.90 since it is so effective.

The Medicube Hypochlorous Acid Peel Shot has easily become my new favorite! This product works to gently exfoliate your face and effectively removes excess sebum and dead skin cells. I simply apply a dropper full and rub it into my skin. As I rub, I start to feel and see the pilling, which is the exfoliation process in action. After I cleanse, my skin feels noticeably smoother and even looks more glowy.

Perfect at home peeling honestly, I have combination skin where have oily spots and dry spots and a problem t zones, this works wonderfully. I do feel my skin pretty renewed, it’s gentle yet effective and truly makes difference, just softer and more radiant skin what it feels like. As expected high quality and little goes a long way. Definitely do a skin test prior to using just in case, but it works great on my combo skin!
